„auch“ = OWKH: au followed by the hard ch.

tr: „Baby“ = BEE-bi: a burada ee, y ise i.
en: „Baby“ = BAY-bee: here a sounds like ay, and y like ee.

tr: „ist teuer“: iki t tek t olur: is-TOY-a.
en: „ist teuer“: the two t sounds merge into one: is-TOY-a.
„Apotheke“ = a-po-TAY-kuh: th is just a t here too.

tr: Fuchs: FUKS. Kısa u, ardından net bir ks.
en: Fuchs: FUKS. A short u, as in put, then a clear ks.

tr: „voll“ = FOL: o'dan sonra da l ince ve kısa.
en: „voll“ = FOL: after the o the l is light and short too.

tr: „kommt Tanja“: kom-TAN-ya, t bir kez söylenir.
en: „kommt Tanja“: kom-TAN-ya, the t is said only once.

tr: „Linie“ = LİİN-ye: ilk i uzun, sondaki -ie YE.
en: „Linie“ = LEEN-yuh: the first i is long, the final -ie is YUH.

tr: „Theater“ = te-AA-ter: th yalnız t, h okunmaz.
en: „Theater“ = tay-AA-ter: th is just t, the h is not pronounced.

tr: „Alphabet“ = al-fa-BEET: ph her zaman f okunur.
en: „Alphabet“ = al-fa-BAYT: ph is always read as f.

tr: „Cousine“ = ku-Zİİ-ne: ou u okunur, c k okunur.
en: „Cousine“ = koo-ZEE-nuh: ou is read as oo, c as k.
„Ferien“ = FAY-ryen: two syllables, the -ien here is YEN.

tr: „laufe“ = LAU-fe: au kayar, f ondan sonra gelir.
en: „laufe“ = LAU-fuh (au as in now): au glides, then the f follows.

tr: „Orange“ = o-RAN-je: g burada da j gibi yumuşak.
en: „Orange“ = o-RAN-zhuh: here too the g is soft, like the s in pleasure.
„stimmt's“ = SHTIMTS: the question melody rises at the end.

tr: „Friseur“ = fri-ZÖÖR: eu burada oy değil, uzun ö.
en: „Friseur“ = free-ZÖÖR: eu here is not oy, but a long ö.

tr: „war's“ = VAARS: uzun a, r hafif, sonda yalnız s.
en: „war's“ = VAARS: a long a, a light r, and just an s at the end.

tr: wachsen: VAK-sen. Burada chs, ks okunur; ş değil.
en: wachsen: VAK-sen. Here chs is read as ks, not as sh.

tr: „Laptop“ = LEP-top: ilk hecedeki a, e gibi okunur.
en: „Laptop“ = LEP-top: the a in the first syllable is said like an e.
In „Lesen“ and „Kochen“ the voice stays up, in „Tanzen“ it falls.

tr: Quittung: KVİT-tung. Yine kv; ardından kısa bir i.
en: Quittung: KVIT-toong. kv again; then a short i.

tr: „draußen“ DRAU-sen, „schau“ ŞAU: au her yerde aynı.
en: „draußen“ DRAU-sen, „schau“ SHAU (rhymes with now): au is always the ow of now.

tr: „mach's“ = MAHS: sert ch'den sonra doğrudan s gelir.
en: „mach's“ = MAKHS: the s comes straight after the hard ch.

tr: Her şehir adında ton hafif yükselir, „Mainz“ta iner.
en: On each city name the voice rises slightly, on „Mainz“ it falls.

tr: „mit Tom“: t ile t buluşur, bir kez söylenir: mi-TOM.
en: „mit Tom“: t meets t and is said once: mi-TOM.

tr: „Team“ = TİİM, „Meeting“ = Mİİ-ting: ea ve ee uzun i.
en: „Team“ = TEEM, „Meeting“ = MEE-ting: ea and ee are both a long ee.

tr: „gibt's“ = GİPTS: b burada p gibi, sonra ts. Tek hece.
en: „gibt's“ = GIPTS: b sounds like p here, then ts. One syllable.

tr: „Italien“ = i-TAA-lyen: vurgu ikinci hecede, sonu YEN.
en: „Italien“ = ee-TAA-lyen: the stress is on the second syllable, the ending is YEN.

tr: „Handy“ = HEN-di: a burada e gibi, y ise i gibi okunur.
en: „Handy“ = HEN-dee: a sounds like e here, and y like ee.
